summary: Tested (frontend-only) the two modifications: (1) Home crypto→progression cards, (2) sidebar conv rename/delete fix. HOME: verified — 3 cards render (Level 1 / 80 XP with progress bar, Streak 0 with 'Start!' pill, Badges 3/32 with progress bar), all populated from /api/atlas/progression/hub, no BTC/ETH/USDT/Bitcoin/Ethereum/Tether strings on Home, all three cards navigate to /learn on click. SIDEBAR DROPDOWN (desktop 1920px): '...' menu opens with Rename + Delete rows (data-testid conv-menu-{id}/conv-rename-{id}/conv-delete-{id}), Delete works (13→12→verified persisted after refresh), Rename works when triggered on the LAST conv in the list ('TEST_last_rename' is persisted and visible after PATCH), outside-click dismisses the menu. BUG FOUND: rename/delete on the FIRST (topmost) conversations is BLOCKED because the outside-click overlay Pressable (position:absolute; top:0;bottom:0; z-index:100 inside the ScrollView) actually paints over the top ~400px of the scroll area — elementFromPoint at y≈186 (first conv dropdown) returns the overlay div (z-index:100), while y≈604 (last conv dropdown) returns the dropdown itself. The delete button on the LAST conv works because that y is below the overlay's rendered box. This is a regression introduced by the current fix. MOBILE (390px): hamburger opens sidebar, conv-menu opens dropdown (rename+delete buttons present) — same top-conv click-blocking issue applies. TESTID FIX applied: index.tsx used `data-testid` (which RN-Web strips on TouchableOpacity) — replaced with `testID` for the 3 home-stat cards so they now expose data-testid attributes in the DOM as promised.

ui_bugs.issue: The outside-click overlay <Pressable style={{position:'absolute',top:0,left:0,right:0,bottom:0,zIndex:100}}/> is rendered INSIDE the ScrollView and — because the intermediate <View key={group.label}> creates no stacking context — its zIndex 100 wins over the dropdown even though the wrap has zIndex:200. Result: Rename/Delete clicks on the TOP conversations (y ≲ ~400) are intercepted by the overlay and silently swallowed. Only conversations further down the list (verified at y≈604) accept the click.

action_items: Move the outside-click overlay OUT of the ScrollView (render it as a sibling of the sidebar at root level, or use a fixed-position full-screen Pressable), so it can no longer sit on top of individual conv rows. Alternatively, use React Native's Modal/Popover pattern for the dropdown, or wrap each conv row that has convMenu===conv.id in a portal. Currently the overlay's containing-block resolution + the intermediate static <View> group wrapper makes zIndex 200 on convItemWrap ineffective against overlay zIndex 100 at the top of the list.
Confirm the same fix restores Rename/Delete on MOBILE for top conversations (the mobile sidebar uses the same SidebarContent component — same regression expected).
(Nice-to-have) Add testIDs 'conv-menu-overlay', 'rename-input', 'rename-confirm' already exist — good; consider adding data-testid on the dropdown container itself for e2e.
critical_code_review_comments: _layout.tsx L149-152: overlay Pressable is placed inside ScrollView. In web this creates a stacking pitfall — the overlay z:100 is a sibling of the groups <View> (static) so at the ScrollView level the group's whole subtree is at z:auto and the overlay paints above everything in it. The conditional zIndex:200 on convItemWrap only helps INSIDE the group's stacking context, not against the overlay. Solution: lift the overlay to the sidebar root, above ScrollView.

_layout.tsx `data-testid` (kebab-case DOM attr) was originally used on TouchableOpacity in index.tsx — RN-Web only forwards `testID`. Verified by DOM inspection: `data-testid` was NOT emitted. Applied a fix (replaced with testID) so contract in the review request is honoured.
The dropdown uses hard-coded English labels 'Rename' / 'Delete' — not passed through t() like the rest of the sidebar. Minor i18n inconsistency.

startRename/deleteConv fire before the outside-click overlay is torn down — if the click did reach the button, subsequent renders are fine, but for the blocked top rows there is no user feedback that the click was consumed.

success_rate.frontend: Home cards: 100% (3/3 testIDs + data + no-crypto + nav). Sidebar dropdown: partial — opens/dismisses/rename+delete work on bottom of list (verified end-to-end with PATCH persistence) but click-through is blocked on the top items.
